The '''Battle of the Skaross system''' was the name of a battle between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in the Imperial [[Skaross system/Legends|Skaross system]] during the last stages of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The battle resulted in the saving of a Sith factory station from a Republic fleet.

==The battle==
The Republic discovered that a key Imperial weapons manufacturing station was in the Skaross system so the Republic command send a bombers' fleet to destroy it. When the Sith understood the situation they called for help the elite [[Empire's Fury]] squadron and quickly the Republic fleet was repulsed.
